messages:
zoe: Heads up: onboarding sample fails schema validate when function/tool calls return JSON strings in retry path. Repro below.

zoe: Node repro:
```
await client.callTool('parse_user', {text})
// expected: {name: ..., attrs: [...]} 
// actual on retry: "{\"name\":...}" (string)
```

mike: I can repro. Looks like retry middleware returns raw body without running parse helper.

rita: Short term: add README troubleshooting and a small guard in sample to normalize results. Long term: SDK must promise native types for structured outputs across languages and auth flows.

zoe: Agreed. I'll open a PR for the Node SDK to ensure retry path calls the same parse pipeline. Mike please add a unit test that simulates 401 + refresh.

mike: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/912. Added test and changelog entry.

ci-bot: Created issue #1533: "sdk: normalize structured outputs on retry (json-mode)" and linked PR 912.

rita: Also adding a CI smoke job for sample apps that runs the repro with a stubbed token endpoint. That should catch regressions.

zoe: Thanks team — once merged I'll update onboarding checklist and ping support to close customer tickets.
